about: NOGGIN host voice. Record each line as public/voice/<id>.mp3 (extra takes: <id>-2.mp3, <id>-3.mp3). Any line you skip simply stays silent. Then upload them; the server finds them automatically

say: Good evening, and welcome to NOGGIN! Phones out, brains on.
Welcome to NOGGIN — the only show where using your head is compulsory.
New round! Roll those dice.
Here we go again — dice at the ready.
Last orders! Every Spark you win this round counts double.
It's last orders, folks. Double Sparks. Don't bottle it.
Wildcard! You pick the game. Choose wisely.
Ooh, a Wildcard. The power is yours.
Brain Drain! Five seconds. Go!
Brain Drain! Quick — think!
Give them a round of applause!
The studio loves you. Two Sparks!
Pickpocket! Hands where I can see them.
Cheeky! A Spark straight out of the leader's pocket.
Swap seats! All change.
Swap! Somebody's not happy about that.
Going up! Mind the doors.
Stage Lift — all the way across.
Now THAT is how you play NOGGIN!
Massive! Somebody's having a good night.
Lovely stuff.
Sparks for you!
Ooh, that's gotta hurt.
Unlucky. Chin up.
It's a Showdown! Two enter, one leaves with the Sparks.
Showdown time. Everyone else — pick a side!
Buzzer Battle! Fingers on buzzers.
Buzz first, answer fast.
Tug of Wits! Pull that rope with your brain.
Heave! Every right answer pulls the rope.
Bid to Win! How many can you name? Don't get greedy.
Bid to Win. Big talk — now prove it.
Nerve! Bank it or bust.
How brave are you feeling? Bank before it busts.
We've got a tie! It's the Noggin-Off — closest number wins the whole show.
Sudden death! The Noggin-Off decides it.
Round game time — everybody plays!
Here's your round game. Good luck!
Quick Draw! Wait for it… wait for it…
Count Flash! Remember everything — you don't know what I'll ask.
Odd Spot! One of these is not like the others.
Colour Clash! Read the ink, not the word.
Higher or Lower! Two strikes and you're out.
Memory Lane! Watch closely… and the last one's backwards.
Close Call! Closest guess wins.
Unscramble! Sort those letters out.
Sketch and Sabotage! Somebody's drawing… and somebody's lying.
Noise Annoys! Make some noise — no words!
Caption This! Make me laugh.
Fib Factory! Lie through your teeth.
Mind Meld! Two minds, one word. No talking!
Majority Rules! Go with the crowd.
Relay Sums! Pass the baton — quickly!
Bomb Squad! Talk to each other… or it's boom.
We have a winner! Ladies and gentlemen, the champion of NOGGIN!
And the winner is… take a bow!
